evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: The current interrupt-recovery proof still uses an over-broad predicate at lines 1342-1343: `rc not in (0, None)` accepts any ordinary nonzero exit, including a normal `recover` refusal that leaves the pending `drained` record unchanged. The following checks only compare record state, so such a refusal can falsely satisfy the interrupted-recovery case even when the drain kill hook never terminated the process. Because the case is specifically an interruption at the drain kill point, it should require the SIGKILL status (`-9`) rather than any nonzero exit.
